stamps.description_en: Ride the rainbow water slide to the splash pool
stamps.description_zh: 乘坐一次彩虹水滑梯并安全滑入戏水池
近距离观察3种不同的可爱动物

stamps.description_en: Pet the puppy and feed it a yummy dog biscuit
stamps.description_zh: 抚摸小狗一次并喂食一块香脆狗零食

clues.description_en: Fly across the barrier to the high observation deck and illuminate with flashlight
clues.description_zh: 飞行越过障碍到达高空观察台，并用手电筒照亮

clues.description_en: Stay invisible along the public walkway and shine flashlight at the shy owl
clues.description_zh: 保持隐形站在林荫步道，用手电筒照亮害羞猫头鹰

clues.description_en: Follow the puppy's glowing pawprint trail to the secret spot and shine flashlight
clues.description_zh: 跟随小狗留下的发光脚印到达终点，用手电筒照亮
